   198	    def __init__(
   199	        self,
   200	        *,
   201	        get_running_operation: Callable[[str], ManagedBackupOperation | None] | None = None,
   202	    ) -> None:
   203	        if get_running_operation is not None and not callable(get_running_operation):
   204	            raise TypeError("get_running_operation must be callable or None")
   205	        self._get_running_operation = get_running_operation
   206	        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
   207	        self._runners: dict[str, _RunnerConnection] = {}

   211	    def is_runner_connected(self, runner_id: str) -> bool:
   212	        """Return whether this event loop currently owns a runner socket."""
   213	        if not isinstance(runner_id, str) or not runner_id:
   214	            raise ValueError("runner_id must not be empty")

   217	    async def register_runner(self, runner_id: str, websocket: RelayWebSocket) -> None:
   218	        """Register one current outbound runner connection, replacing stale state."""
   219	        if not isinstance(runner_id, str) or not runner_id:
   220	            raise ValueError("runner_id must not be empty")
   221	        durable_operation = (
   222	            None if self._get_running_operation is None else self._get_running_operation(runner_id)
   223	        )
   224	        durable_job_id = None if durable_operation is None else durable_operation.job_id
   225	        clients_to_close: list[_ClientConnection] = []
   226	        async with self._lock:
   227	            previous = self._runners.get(runner_id)
   228	            if previous is not None:
   229	                for transfer_id in tuple(previous.sessions):
   230	                    client = self._clients.pop(transfer_id, None)
   231	                    if client is not None:
   232	                        self._close_client_queue(client)
   233	                        clients_to_close.append(client)
   234	            self._runners[runner_id] = _RunnerConnection(websocket=websocket)
   235	            maintenance = self._maintenance.get(runner_id)
   236	            maintenance_job_id = None if maintenance is None else maintenance.job_id
   237	            if durable_job_id is not None and maintenance is None:
   238	                acknowledgement = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
   239	                self._maintenance[runner_id] = _RunnerMaintenance(
   240	                    durable_job_id,
   241	                    acknowledgement,
   242	                )
   243	                maintenance_job_id = durable_job_id
   244	        if previous is not None:
   245	            await previous.websocket.close(code=4001, reason="Runner connection replaced")
   246	        for client in clients_to_close:
   247	            await client.websocket.close(code=4002, reason="Runner connection replaced")

   249	            control_message = '{"job_id":"' + maintenance_job_id + '","type":"quiesce"}'
